newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks seen stronger, helped by forex, Dow.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks seen stronger, helped by forex, Dow.

text.p: Tokyo stocks are likely to strengthen in the Friday trading session, carrying over bullish sentiment from Thursday, brokers said.
With the yen near 115 to the dollar and strength on Wall Street overnight stocks could try for new highs, they said.
On Thursday the 225-share Nikkei average gained 274.53 points, or 1.35 percent, to close at 20,564.46. Its June futures jumped 270 points to 20,580.
"June futures and options will be settled this morning and after that, buying in sectors reliant on domestic demand and laggard exporters should emerge," one broker said.
It briefly touched a new high for the year of 20,791.08. The previous high was 20,707.77 set on June 4.
